items.title: commands in code
items.body: type / in Aide code to see every command. /context shows what fills pi's memory, /compact frees it up, /goal keeps pi working until something is done.

items.title: effort for pi
items.body: models that think get an effort control under the box. low answers fast; high thinks longer. a running chat switches right away.

items.title: hide keys from the model
items.body: wrap a key or password in two bars, like ||sk-…||, and pi uses it without ever seeing it.

items.title: text Aide from your phone
items.body: connect with Photon in settings and alles sets up iMessage and lets your number through. if Aide needs your ok, the text tells you.

items.title: buttons you can see
items.body: every button in settings has an outline now, so it doesn't read as plain text.
